description: Call first, before any advice: returns how to handle the type of situation, one playbook from the CDO Agent know-how with the facts to ask for, what to look up with get_delivery_guidance and the shape of the answer, not the advice itself. Without a situation, or with list, it returns the types of situation that have a playbook, one sentence each.

situation.description: The type of situation in plain text, for example two vendor proposals to choose between. Leave it out, or send list, for the types of situation.

title: Get the playbook for a situation
